errors.evidence: The y-axis scale is not explicitly defined in the chart. The description incorrectly states that the scale ranges up to the maximum data value of 46.0%, which is an inaccurate representation of how chart axes are typically constructed (they usually end on a round number, like 50%).

errors.text_span: Стойностите са разположени на интервали от 1%.
errors.evidence: The chart's y-axis has no visible tick marks or intervals. The description hallucinates that the values are spaced at 1% intervals.
In the description of the 'няма промяна' (no change) category, the value for 'В бранша' (in the industry) is incorrectly stated as 28.4%. The chart shows this value to be 46.0%.

errors.text_span: Най-висока стойност има за „нейният дял се е намалил“ с 46,0% за „В бранша“ и 33,1% за „В страната“
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. The highest value (46.0%) is for the 'няма промяна' (no change) category, not 'нейният дял се е намалил' (its share has decreased). The values for the 'decreased' category are also incorrect and swapped: it is 28.4% for 'В страната' (in the country) and 33.1% for 'В бранша' (in the industry).
